title: Strengthen to 'only the last lamp on' then convert to all-on: IMO 1993 P6(b)
intent: Prove part (b) of IMO 1993 P6 — when n = 2^k, all lamps are on after n^2 − 1 steps — by strengthening the target to the intermediate state 'after n·(n−1) steps only the last lamp is on', which the glue hands from last_lamp_only_of_two_pow (the ZMod-2 core) to all_on_of_last_only (the final sweep that converts 'only the last lamp on' into 'all lamps on').

parent.name: imo1993_p6_b
parent.statement:
problem imo1993_p6_b (n k : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hn : n = 2 ^ k) (hk : 0 < k) :
    ∀ i : Fin n, lampsAfter n (n ^ 2 - 1) i = true

children.name: all_on_of_last_only
children.statement:
lemma all_on_of_last_only {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 1 < n)
    (h : ∀ i : Fin n, lampsAfter n (n * (n - 1)) i = decide (i.val = n - 1)) :
    ∀ i : Fin n, lampsAfter n (n ^ 2 - 1) i = true
children.closed_by: `key (n - 1) le_rfl i` (the internal induction over the position j), then `lia`
children.note: The final phase: given that after n·(n−1) steps only the last lamp L_{n−1} is on, the lamps turn on one by one and after n²−1 steps all are on. Proved by an internal induction on the position j, using the project lemmas pos_after, step_lamps and bool_toggle.

children.name: last_lamp_only_of_two_pow
children.statement:
theorem last_lamp_only_of_two_pow (n k : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hk : 0 < k) (hn : n = 2 ^ k) :
    ∀ i : Fin n, lampsAfter n (n * (n - 1)) i = decide (i.val = n - 1)
children.closed_by: `core` (the ZMod-2 induction), the correspondence `glue`/`aux`, closed by `simp` on `by_cases hi : i = lasti (2 ^ k)`
children.note: The strengthened core: after n·(n−1) steps only the last lamp L_{n−1} is on, proved by induction on k via the ZMod 2 model (core), transported back to Bool by glue and aux.

applicability.goal_shape: ∀ i, P(i) after a fixed number of steps (a final-time condition), reached by first proving an intermediate state — 'only one distinguished lamp is on' — that is stronger in structure and easier to reach by a model or induction argument, then converting that state to the target by a deterministic sweep.
applicability.use_when: The final state ('all on') is the result of a uniform sweep from a simpler distinguished state ('only the last lamp on'), and that distinguished state is exactly what a stronger induction (here over k via a ZMod 2 model) produces for free — i.e. when the target is reachable as strengthen-then-convert.
applicability.avoid_when: The intermediate state is not actually stronger or more convenient; the conversion sweep is not uniform in n (here all_on_of_last_only needs its own induction over the position, which only works because the sweep is one lamp at a time around the circle); or the strengthened core would need the very theorem being proved.

consequences: Splits the goal into a strengthened core (after n·(n−1) steps exactly 'only the last lamp is on') and a final phase (a deterministic sweep that turns that state into 'all on'). Each half carries its own induction: the core by induction on k over a ZMod 2 model, the final phase by induction on the position j. The halves must agree on the intermediate state — last_lamp_only_of_two_pow's conclusion is exactly all_on_of_last_only's hypothesis h, and the glue also discharges a side condition hn2 : 1 < n that all_on_of_last_only needs. Failure modes: if the strengthened state does not match the conversion lemma's hypothesis exactly (same step count, same 'only lamp L_{n−1}' predicate), the glue needs an extra rewrite; if the conversion is not uniform in n it cannot be a standalone lemma.
